# PetDate — پت‌دیت

PetDate (پت‌دیت) is the Persian pet playmate, pet shop, adoption, and online vet-consult platform. Web and Telegram share one account.

- Home: [PetDate](https://petdate.ir/)
- FAQ: [PetDate FAQ](https://petdate.ir/faq)
- Pet shop: [PetDate shop](https://petdate.ir/shop)
- Vet consult: [online veterinary consultation](https://petdate.ir/vet-consult)
- Adoption: [adoption listings](https://petdate.ir/adoption)
- Magazine: [PetDate magazine](https://petdate.ir/magazine)
- Login: [OTP login](https://petdate.ir/auth/login)
- Sitemap: [XML sitemap](https://petdate.ir/sitemap.xml)
- Full AI summary: [llms-full.txt](https://petdate.ir/llms-full.txt)
- Contact: [hello@petdate.ir](mailto:hello@petdate.ir)
- Telegram bot: [Petdatebot](https://t.me/Petdatebot)

## What the product does

- Find playmates (همبازی) for dogs and cats
- Browse and buy from the pet shop (پت‌شاپ)
- Discover pets available for adoption (پذیرش)
- Request online veterinary consultation (مشاوره دامپزشک)

Primary language is Persian (fa), RTL UI. Playmate chat and checkout require login. Veterinary support is online consultation, not a clinic directory.
